understanding.goal_understanding: Complete each level by positioning the selectable pieces so that every goal tile marked '+' is occupied by a selectable piece at the same time; when the engine reports WIN for the level, progress until the full game is won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions (MOVE_UP/DOWN/LEFT/RIGHT) shift the currently selected piece by one grid cell (3 pixels) when not blocked by walls/objects, and sometimes can push an adjacent pushable block if it is directly in the movement direction; if blocked, the piece does not move. Levels can contain multiple selectable pieces, and control is switched with CLICK on the exact pixel position of another selectable. Walls/boundaries and the movement_blocked hints are not perfectly reliable and require testing, as some walls may behave unexpectedly.
